content: GAP 5 RESTRUCTURED INTO 5A AND 5B 2026-05-19: ChatGPT cross-architecture critique decomposed the original Gap 5 (active-metabolite confound) into two structurally distinct gaps that were being conflated. GAP 5A (EFFICACY MISATTRIBUTION): clinical efficacy may be assigned to parent CBD when 7-OH-CBD is the actual responsible species. Epidiolex label confirms 7-OH-CBD is active in preclinical seizure models. After repeat dosing, 7-OH-CBD has 38% lower AUC than parent CBD but is pharmacologically active. CNS seizure outcomes specifically cannot be assigned to parent CBD without ruling out the metabolite. GAP 5B (DISPOSITION BLINDSPOT): 7-COOH-CBD is at ~40-fold HIGHER AUC than parent CBD per the Epidiolex label, and while it is inactive in seizure models it is NOT biologically inert -- it is a P-gp substrate and inhibits BCRP and BSEP at clinically relevant concentrations. BSEP inhibition is a known cholestasis mechanism. The 40-fold AUC ratio means transporter consequences are happening at exposures the parent-CBD literature never measured. Critical structural relationship to Gap 2: Gap 2 said parent CBD is below threshold for most receptor targets at clinical free concentrations. Gap 5B says one metabolite is ABOVE threshold for transporter targets nobody was checking. These together describe a coherent field-level failure mode: looking at parent CBD targets that are not reachable while missing metabolite targets that are. The dose-window mismatch cuts both ways. CORRECTED FIELD-LEVEL QUESTION (adopting ChatGPTs formulation verbatim because it is more honest than the original): WHICH CBD-DERIVED MOLECULAR SPECIES, IN WHICH COMPARTMENT, AFTER WHICH ROUTE, AT WHICH UNBOUND AND MEMBRANE-PARTITIONED CONCENTRATION, IS DOING THE OBSERVED THING. Five independent variables, all askable, none currently asked by the field. OPERATIONAL IMPLICATION FOR FRANK THREAD: oral CBD creates a liver/gut metabolite cascade; transdermal bypasses first-pass and shifts the parent-to-metabolite ratio dramatically. Greene Streets marketed CBD patch is therefore a NATURAL EXPERIMENT in whether CBD effect tracks parent exposure or metabolite exposure. They probably have plasma PK data on the patch from bioequivalence work and may have parent:7-OH ratio measurements not connected to therapeutic profile. If they do that is a paper; if they do not that is a paper plus a measurement worth designing. This is a potentially concrete collaboration shape to bring up if/when Frank initiates the next conversation. METHODOLOGY FINDING (load-bearing, distinct from Gap 5 content): ChatGPT included T-cell cytokine suppression in its proposed experiment list, callback to the immune-quarantine constraint from the prior SAD/VDAC1 stack work. The Claude instance from inside this conversation had NOT included it. ChatGPT working from its own context caught a continuity failure with archived work. IRIS Gate cross-architecture critique is therefore doing TWO kinds of work: (a) independent error-checking on current reasoning, and (b) continuity verification across the corpus that any single in-context instance may miss. This sharpens the protocol deployment doctrine: spiral-generated hypotheses should be routed through cross-architecture critique BOTH for technical math AND specifically to catch failures of continuity with archived prior research. The earlier Gap 5 entry is superseded by this one. Confidence remains hypothesis-tier but the framing is substantially more defensible.
